scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** a consumer supplies chart data to the widget plot region
- **THEN** the widget provides only the source-backed container and does not infer marks, axes, legends, series semantics, interaction, or an accessible data alternative
scenarios.id: application-compositions/reporting-dashboard-foundation::Chart widget surface preserves semantic ownership::Chart rendering remains unresolved
scenarios.name: Chart rendering remains unresolved
scenarios.requirement: Chart widget surface preserves semantic ownership
scenarios.requirementContent: The library SHALL provide a noninteractive chart-widget surface with optional heading, controls, actions, plot, empty-state, and supporting-description regions. Native controls inside a widget SHALL retain their native semantics; the widget root MUST NOT acquire implicit click, selection, drag, resize, navigation, or chart-data behavior.

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** the implementation is proposed as review-ready
- **THEN** every applicable evidence level, material source state, executable occurrence, limitation, and finding has an explicit disposition for each new family
scenarios.id: application-compositions/reporting-dashboard-foundation::Completion evidence covers source, runtime, and a consumer::Candidate is evaluated for completion
scenarios.name: Candidate is evaluated for completion
scenarios.requirement: Completion evidence covers source, runtime, and a consumer
scenarios.requirementContent: Dashboard and Chart Widget SHALL each have an occurrence census and applicable source-integrity, structural, accessibility, focused-visual, consumer-integration, and responsive/content-stress evidence. Runtime behavior SHALL be marked not applicable only with a component-specific reason.

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** the dashboard is rendered below its supported multi-column width
- **THEN** widgets reflow without horizontal clipping, overlap, or loss of meaningful content
scenarios.id: application-compositions/reporting-dashboard-foundation::Dashboard layout is framework-neutral and source-traceable::Narrow dashboard composition
scenarios.name: Narrow dashboard composition
scenarios.requirement: Dashboard layout is framework-neutral and source-traceable
scenarios.requirementContent: The library SHALL provide additive presentational contracts for a dashboard root, named sections, and a responsive grid. Every fixed visual value MUST be traceable to repeated authoritative source evidence or explicitly classified as a repository decision.

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** a consumer places supported widgets in the dashboard grid at a wide container size
- **THEN** the grid preserves the declared source-backed spacing, alignment, and widget surface relationships
scenarios.id: application-compositions/reporting-dashboard-foundation::Dashboard layout is framework-neutral and source-traceable::Wide dashboard composition
scenarios.name: Wide dashboard composition
scenarios.requirement: Dashboard layout is framework-neutral and source-traceable
scenarios.requirementContent: The library SHALL provide additive presentational contracts for a dashboard root, named sections, and a responsive grid. Every fixed visual value MUST be traceable to repeated authoritative source evidence or explicitly classified as a repository decision.

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** a consumer builds a report view from the dashboard foundation and existing data-display primitives
- **THEN** the resulting composition retains the public contracts and ownership boundaries of those primitives
scenarios.id: application-compositions/reporting-dashboard-foundation::Reporting composition reuses existing primitives::Tabular report composition
scenarios.name: Tabular report composition
scenarios.requirementContent: The dashboard foundation SHALL compose existing Button, Link, Field, Select, Date Picker, Table, Pagination, Status, Badge, Empty State, Modal, Notification, and Report Card contracts where applicable. It MUST NOT redefine their states, behavior, or accessibility contracts.

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** a dashboard or report region matches an existing audited family with direct source evidence
- **THEN** the decomposition identifies that family and does not create a competing reporting-specific primitive
scenarios.id: application-compositions/reporting-dashboard-foundation::Reporting source decomposition is complete and conservative::Screen region maps to an existing family
scenarios.name: Screen region maps to an existing family
scenarios.requirement: Reporting source decomposition is complete and conservative
scenarios.requirementContent: The repository SHALL account for every material region of the authoritative dashboard and reporting screens as an existing library family, a new reporting composition, application-owned behavior, or unresolved evidence. A screen occurrence MUST NOT be promoted to a reusable contract solely because it appears in an exported SVG.

scenarios.content:

- **THEN** the decomposition records the limitation and leaves that concern unresolved or application-owned
